test_train: test the DQNTest class and its test_train method that trains a BoltzmannDQN agent on a simple EFG game
create_BoltzmannDQN: create a BoltzmannDQN agent with specified player ID, state size, num actions, hidden layers, replay buffer, batch size, epsilon, and eta parameters
run_rl_training_loop: run a reinforcement learning training loop using rl_environment.Environment and agent.step to collect rewards over 100 episodes
update_prev_q_network: update the previous Q-network of a BoltzmannDQN agent after training completes
create_RLAgentPolicy: create an RLAgentPolicy from a game and BoltzmannDQN agent to compute soft-max action probabilities
